Based on the screenshots provided, here is the exact description of what is visible:

(1) **Yes**, there is a small flower/asterisk-like logo mark visible. It appears in two places: first as a tiny icon inside the pill-shaped badge above the main headline ("On-demand marketing director..."), and second, more prominently, immediately to the left of the status text below the search bar.

(2) **The color is a soft orange (or salmon/peach tone).** It matches the color of the "Analyzing..." button and the "Get started" button in the header.

(3) **Yes**, there is a status text that reads **"Reading your homepage — running 18 deterministic checks..."**. While it is difficult to confirm a "shimmer" animation from a static image, the text is styled in a way that suggests activity (it is bolded and paired with the animated-looking flower icon).

(4) **The header logo at the top left** consists of the same black, 8-petal flower/asterisk icon followed by the word **"Marketwise"** in a clean, black sans-serif font.

(5) **Screenshot 2 shows the Results state.** The loading animation is gone, replaced by a detailed report card titled "INSTANT DIAGNOSIS" displaying a score of **42 Readiness / 100**, progress bars for SEO, Messaging, and Conversion signals, and a list of specific findings (e.g., "No clear call-to-action on the homepage").
